texts.text:
Day 12,

With the toppling of Sunnyglade to the orcish horde, I had my doubts we would ever see it reclaimed as our own.

However, something seems to be driving them off. Something even the foul orcs fear.

Once Kel'Thuzad was whole again, Arthas led the Scourge south to Dalaran. There the lich would obtain the powerful spellbook of Medivh, and use it to summon Archimonde back into the world. From that point on, Archimonde himself would begin the Legion's final invasion. Not even the wizards of the Kirin Tor could stop Arthas' forces from stealing Medivh's book, and soon Kel'Thuzad had all he needed to perform his spell.

1.title: Archimonde's Return and the Flight to Kalimdor

npc:10136.text: Lady Sylvanas has ordered the investigation of some of the natural phenomena of Azeroth. She feels there is something great to be learned from its secretive past.$B$BI know not how she learned such things, but I trust her completely, so I will do my best.$B$BI am currently investigating slimes, oozes and such. The creatures all seem to be similar in make up, but greatly affected by their environment.$B$BI could use your help in gathering samples of the creatures..

npc:10839.text: Well met, friend.  I am Officer Garush, and I am a proud member of a world-wide organization known as the Argent Dawn.  Our cause is to fight swiftly and mercilessly against any element of evil that surfaces in Azeroth.  We are not a political body, nor do we ever wish to become one.  Our cause is singular, and to that end we call both the Horde and Alliance as friends - friends in the cause of stamping out evil!$B$BFor the Dawn, my $g brother : sister;!

npc:11033.text: I'm what you call a capitalist, $r.

npc:11035.text: The plaguelands are an excellent place to strike against the Scourge!

npc:11036.text: Through knowledge, may we find salvation.

npc:11216.text: Hello young $g Master:Mistress;. I am Eva Sarkhoff and this is my husband, Lucien. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

And go where? It was all that we knew; all that we had known and all that we would ever know.$B$BEventually, we lost contact with the Barovs and ultimately, were separated from the household. We knew not what happened to the other servants, only that there were screams. Tortured screams.$B$BKnowing that we had nowhere to go, Lucien and I were forced to hide in our quarters. During the day, when the school was relatively quiet, Lucien would sneak out to scrounge up food and drink.

Certainly, $g sir:miss;. We were once servants of the house Barov: What is now known as the Scholomance.$B$BI was the head maid and Lucien was Master Barov's butler.$B$BWe had worked for the Barovs for decades, until...$B$B<Eva weeps.>

Oh it's just so horrible, $g sir:miss;. The house Barov was once full of life... full of splendor. The manor was the Barov's primary residence amidst their far reaching empire.$B$BLucien and I noticed that as the days progressed, the Barovs became depressed. Despondent. Paranoia and rage often overcame the master and missus. At night, we could hear the Barovs arguing in their chambers. From what we understood, their greed had 'broken the dam,' so to speak.

Restraints? There are things in this world far more restraining than bars and shackles, young $g master:mistress;. The undead surrounded us, constantly tormenting us with horrifying acts of depravity.$B$BFinally, he came. He introduced himself as Doctor Theolen Krastinov. We came to know him as 'The Butcher.'

We did this for about six months and watched as the house went through horrifying changes. Foul monsters roamed through the manor at will. Dark cultists populated every inch with various paraphernalia relating to rituals and sacrifices. We knew that we could not hide much longer.$B$BAs expected, we were found and captured. They stripped us of all our clothes and laid us out inside a circle of blood. We sat there for days, naked and terrified.

We finally understood what the screams were from. The Butcher exposed us to pain that we did not know existed. He used us in countless experiments, attempting to devise a plague.$B$BThe days turned to weeks. We would have died on the first day had it not been for that cruel bastard keeping us alive through magical means.

We suspect that in order to preserve their fortune and hold of the land - well past their lifespan - the Barovs made a deal with a powerful human mage named Kel'Thuzad.$B$B<Eva shudders.>$B$BFrom this deal sprang the school of necromancy: A place which bore the Cult of the Damned and would become their capital.$B$BAs each week passed, the house Barov became more and more decrepit...$B$BDark beings began to take residence in the various wings of the house. Upkeep became impossible... and disgusting.

npc:12636.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:13697.text: This place... it's cursed.$B$BI barely managed to escape, and I cannot bear to go down through the tunnels again.$B$BMy brother, and sisters though... They were not as fortunate. Trapped inside, they are feverish with the corrupted haze that flows from the evil garden growing there.$B$BPlease, you must help.

npc:13699.text: My sisters and I have come down from the Stonetalon Mountains to put to rest a tragedy from ages past. Unfortunately, we are not powerful enough to accomplish our goals on our own and now seek mortals such as yourself to aid us.$B$BIf you are powerful enough, then we have much to discuss, $c. If you are not, then, for your safety, I will leave the details of my mission out of our conversation.

npc:13717.text: I need no home to know I still have a place in this world, $c. The tribes will see... all of them. They fight amongst one another, and for what? Scraps left over by vultures... lands infested by the Legion... bah!$B$BThe centaur should be proud of their heritage--it is just as noble as any Night elf's or orc's--it is time we started acting like it!

npc:14731.text: Lard keep peace here. Lard also sell fish. Want fish?

npc:14736.text: Welcome to Revantusk Village, stranger. I am Primal Torntusk, leader of the Revantusk trolls.

npc:14737.text: If it's broke, Slagtree can fix it!

npc:14738.text: I've got all the cooking supplies you'll ever need, mon!

npc:14740.text: Fishing is just so pleasant, mon. You know? I owe my state of bliss to my mentor, the greatest angler in the whole world - Nat Pagle. Have you heard of him, mon?$B$BIf you be looking for enlightenment, Nat Pagle be the one who gonna show you the way.

Zul'jin shall return one day, skyborne. Mark my words. Until then, we all hold our positions and do what we can to keep the forest troll population intact.

With that said, as master huntsman of Revantusk Village, it is my responsibility to insure that the world around us is safe for habitation.

The beasts of this area must be kept in check.

npc:227853.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

npc:253066.text:
An outsider approaches me?

I doubt we have much to discuss, unless you are here to aid an old Kolkar.

npc:253471.text:
Welcome to Shen'dralas, or what remains of it.

I hope you can appreciate the majesty of this place, even if it is a haunted shell of its former self.

I'm inclined to agree. Despite our people coming together to survive the Great Sundering it seems as though the city was nonetheless doomed. How pedantic is it that its fall from grace would come from something so mundane as internal strife?

My loyalty was unquestionable in those days, but in the years since I've come to realize that the rebellion was the moment that we truly lost Prince Tortheldrin. Everything that came after is but a consequence of that wound upon his soul.
 
For my part, I try to avoid dwelling on the past, particularly my role in those events.

Try as I might though... it still haunts me.

You speak of this place by name! That is a level of respect, or knowledge, that I would not expect these days. Of the few adventurers I have encountered, most refer to the city simply as "Dire Maul".

While I find that name insulting and diminishing of my people's proud and extensive history, I cannot deny that Eldre'Thalas no longer lives up to its historical grandeur. At times I wonder if I do our city a disservice by preserving its namesake so long after it has fallen.

I hope you can excuse the state the temple and its grounds are in. So much has changed over the past few millennia.

Celebrating my own life as I stare toward the mass grave of so many of my kin feels... selfish. Many among my order remain cloistered in Prince Tortheldrin's inner sanctum, I suspect to hide from their own guilt. Seeing the city from this perspective makes it difficult to avoid painful truths.

I still count myself among the Shen'dralar, but these days I am long estranged from the library I once called home.

I suspected that my fallen brethren would be too stubborn to pass on from Eldre'Thalas completely, and assumed they would either haunt those halls for eternity or venture north to this place here to live out whatever afterlives they sought out for themselves. I painstakingly created these crystals to anchor their spirits more closely with Azeroth, allowing them to experience the world almost as though they were alive.

Indeed, it worked then. And I suspect it is working again now. I think they will be appreciative of you restoring some of their corporeality.

You should go meet them.

The full story requires time that I suspect you do not have, so I will attempt to be brief.

Perhaps the simplest way I can put it: these crystals are anchors. They can be used to permanently--well, so long as the crystals hold I suppose--bind something, someone, or even somewhere onto our plane of Azeroth. Prince Tortheldrin ordered the creation of similar pylons when he chose to bind the demon Immol'thar. Some of the Shen'dralar protested this decision and proposed a compelling alternative, but ultimately the prince was uninterested in debate and eager to silence dissent.

I had an opportunity to study their design before it became too unsafe for me to stay within the city's walls and I fled back to Shen'dralas.

The proposed alternative to demonic entanglement was at odds with what Tortheldrin had already set in motion. Given that he was working with power that tends to cloud one's judgment, it's no surprise that his first instinct was to lash out.

Most everyone who pushed back against his plans to summon and bind a demon were slain that day. Some escaped, including some of my own kin that stood in opposition to the prince, but I have yet to meet other survivors of that schism even after all these thousands of years.

npc:254578.text:
The whole of this valley was once a garden of Eldre'Thalas, but that blighted land ahead of us was the highlight of it all. Nearly everyone contributed to its arrangement and growth. When tensions were high, often many of us would take a stroll to clear our minds.

Had it withered purely from neglect, I suspect it would look no different than the rest of Shen'dralas.

npc:254674.text:
I tended to these gardens long ago. I plucked the weeds. Trimmed the shrubbery. Planted the flowers. Alongside an elven woman, and her enchanted amulet.

Time passed. My bark aged. Weeds retaliated. Bushes wilted. Flowers withered. My branches were stiff and my movement slow, yet the elf and her people still smiled. What I could no longer do, they did in my stead.

But they stopped suddenly. This valley grew quiet. Dark. But all was well, with the elven woman's gift. Then, it was taken.

I was left with no choice. I set myself aflame. To burn it all down. So the restless weeds would not spread further.

I have died, but I still burn. The weeds still grow. I have failed.

npc:255385.text: A visitor to Shen'dralas? To what do we owe the pleasure?

npc:255894.text:
Ah, a worldly explorer!

Can you smell that fresh, ocean air? Just don't inhale too deeply. Sometimes it smells a bit fishy.

npc:256390.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

npc:256438.text: Ah, nothing beats the smell of fresh air with a hint of sweet sap.

npc:257558.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

npc:257591.text: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

npc:257595.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?
Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

npc:260568.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

npc:263120.text:
What the hell do you want? Can't you see I'm busy here?

Why don't you make yourself useful and have Zizplink pour me another drink. Mine's running dry.

npc:3309.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

npc:3310.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

npc:3318.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

npc:3320.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

npc:3354.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

npc:3615.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

npc:4551.text: How may I be of service?

npc:4556.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

npc:5411.text: Welcome to Tanaris, $n. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.

npc:5594.text: In need of some alchemy supplies, are we?  Or do you have other business with me?

npc:6491.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

npc:6546.text: Your errand must mean much, $c, to draw you so deep into the marsh...

npc:6740.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:6929.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

npc:7406.text: Hello there $glad:lass;... the name's Oglethorpe and I may be responsible for one of the amazing gnomish devices you might possess!  If it blew up, then it wasn't me; if it made you rich though, we can discuss royalties!$B$BOh, and if you're from Gnomeregan, you can just take two ninety degree angles, smash them together, and start marching.  I have nothing to say to you.
Well, if it isn't $n!  It's good to see you again; I cannot express my gratitude enough at the help that you've given me and my invention work to date.$B$BWhat can I do for you today?

npc:7564.text: Living out here in the desert is rough! I get so thirsty standing outside in this heat.

npc:7683.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

npc:7763.text: Hi there! I have a proposition for an adventure-seeker such as you, if you are up to the challenge!$B$BAlong with my invention, the Super Egg-O-Matic, I am hard at work aiding the druids with their campaign to save the hippogryphs. The birds are being affected by the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres inhabiting the ruins of Feralas, and their numbers are dwindling.$B$BI collect many different types of eggs.  Will you help and find some for me?

npc:7771.text: I know, I know, I'm out here in the middle of nowhere!$B$BMy home is actually in Ratchet, but after crashing my zeppelin here, I thought I might as well start the research I came here to do!

npc:7776.text: Listen to the stories of an elder. $n. I have many to speak of...

npc:8496.text: Hi there. No, Marvon sure isn't here, and he won't be back for quite some time. Actually, I am getting a little worried about him...$B$BI hope he gets back soon. A large chest arrived for him and it's too heavy for me to lug it inside here! I had to leave it out by the door...

npc:11039.text: Greetings, $N. I am Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff of the Argent Dawn.

npc:258023.text: If you want something done right, you send me to do it.

npc:259352.text: Whatever you want, spit it out already. I've got a long shift ahead of me.

npc:259961.text: Lemme tell ya, kid. It ain't easy bein' a wharfmaster. If you heard all the logistics involved in gettin' something as simple as a crate of apples shipped across the sea, it'd make your head spin.

npc:259962.text: Please, grab any open chair ya like. I'll come take your order in a sec.

npc:5204.text: If we are to make our place in this world, then we will do so through study, and through the will to ignore our fading human instincts.

npc:7876.text: Some people wonder what we're doing out here in the desert.  Well... if I told you, then you'd stay and try to make our profits!

npc:7882.text: We're here to make a profit.  And having our goods stolen is no way to make a profit.

accept.text: Oh, this is just terrible!  I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here.  That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm.  Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was.  Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?$B$BI need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please!  That... or at least find his surveying equipment.  I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.

complete.text:
He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank.  Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.

It seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs.  They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party!  If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!

objectives.text: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Well, what news do you have?  You look like you've been in quite the fight... is Scrimshank alive?

accept.text: Here's your report.  I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore.  He's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; he's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is and how to stop it, give this report to him.  We're going to need all the help we can get.$B$BZil lives in a house on the second tier of the Drag in Orgrimmar.

objectives.text: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

complete.text:
Good work - I'll start my analysis on these now!  I can tell you right from the start though... these are nothing like any insect form I have ever seen.  It's almost as if these bugs are being controlled by an outside force or something.

You need to go talk to Fizzledowser right away; apparently there is an emergency that he needs your help with on the double!  I'm not sure, but I think it involves more of the bugs in the Tanaris desert!

progress.text: You're Junior Surveyor $N, yes?  Quickly now, there is a dire situation at hand!  Do you have the insect parts that Fizzledowser said you would?!

accept.text: I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order.  I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.$B$BI'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him.  If they're ready, bring them to me.

complete.text:
Yes, I have the results right here.  They are... unsettling, to say the least

Our initial suspicion that the bugs are being controlled by an outside force, we believe, is correct.  If this is the case, then we are dealing with not only a very powerful unknown force, but also a malignant one.  These bugs have been changed to be pure ravagers.  I've never seen anything quite like it.

objectives.text: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.

accept.text: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser needs to see this report immediately.  Actually... everyone who can read needs to see this report.  We are facing a grave and serious threat to not only Tanaris and Gadgetzan, but if left unchecked, the entirety of southern Kalimdor.  Heck, even quite possible the whole of Azeroth; this thing has given no indication it will subside.$B$BHave Fizzledowser make a duplicate of the report for you to distribute freely to your allegiance. Everyone must know about this threat!

complete.text:
Thank you for delivering the report, Junior Surveyor $N; here is your pay for your diligent service to the Gadgetzan Water Company.

While I am usually not thrilled about handing out our valuable information carte blanche to those who would otherwise pay good coin for it, I've known Pestlezugg for a number of years now.  If he recommends letting everyone know about it, then so be it.  Give me a moment and I'll make you a copy.

objectives.text: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.  Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.

progress.text: Well Junior Surveyor $N, has ol' Pestlezugg got that report ready yet?

accept.text: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal.  Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption!  A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.$B$B"The name's Oglethorpe, and my homing robot has gone missing!  I will reward you for its recovery!  Please take this beacon to the robot.  Excellent, I now have computed the coordinates for you!  It crashed near the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris!"

complete.text:
You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.

Hums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up.  After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:

"OOX-17/TN is working at least, but it needs major repairs!  It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea.  Are you up for watching over it some more?"

objectives.text: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

progress.text:
You appear to have uncovered the wreckage of... a robotic chicken?  The voice from within the egg crackles to life again:

"Yes, excellent work!  This is indeed my homing robot, though my sensors indicate that it needs a jump start before it can fly back to Booty Bay for repairs.  Go ahead and place the beacon inside the rover.  The beacon will take care of the rest!"

complete.text:
Shiver me timbers!  Ye found the Cap'n's grog!

I owe ye big time, friend.

Seems like a storm is a brewin' outside.  Maybe I'll just keep warm with one o' these here bottles while we wait for it to pass....

progress.text: Sink me!  I'm almost outta booze here!  Cap'n is goin' to weigh anchor and Ol' Slim will be caught dry as the Tanaris Desert.  And once he discovers his port is missing. . . blimey!

accept.text: You sure seem eager to work, matey.  Not sure why some land-loving $r $c is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.$b$bOur ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.$b$bAll the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies!  What I need is a scout.$b$bCheck the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.

objectives.text: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.

accept.text: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:$B$B"I need to move OOX-17/TN to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure.  It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again.  I need you to escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, Steamwheedle Port!  That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things on line!"$B$B"Escort it safely to the port, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay!  Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"

complete.text:
Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-17/TN!  I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance!  My homing robot series needs more developing, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in rebinding costs!

Please, take your choice of any of these items I have.  Hopefully, you will make good use of one of them.  Thank you again for your generous assistance, my robots and I are in your debt!

objectives.text: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
I will analyze this data immediately.  Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.

As for you...  you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful.  Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.

Check back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.

progress.text: Welcome back.  At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit.  Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.

accept.text: I am so lost!$b$bMy wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.$b$bWould you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.

objectives.text: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.

complete.text: Oh, wonderful! Give it here -- let me drink it!

progress.text: Please, tell me you found the dew collectors?

accept.text: Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...$B$BWait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.$B$BUhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.$B$BI mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...

complete.text:
Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... eccentric, I'd say.

And of course he needs my help, yet again.

objectives.text: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: So old Marin's up to it again, eh? What's this concoction made from?

accept.text: When I was a kid, my sister used to do all the cooking. It was horrible! I could barely stomach some of her concoctions -- until I found what I like to call my "secret" ingredient! Add it to anything, and... WOW! It tastes great!$B$BWhat is it, you ask? It's a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. If you want me to help you turn this horrid-tasting brew into something edible, head to the Hinterlands, and look for a small lake there.$B$BOh, and remember, the Violet Tragan can only be found underwater.

objectives.text: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.

complete.text:
You place the hippogryph egg into the machine. A series of beeps follows along with some strange mechanical sounds.

It appears that the Eggometer has weighed, measured, and packaged your egg. Now that's speedy service!

progress.text:
The Super Egg-O-Matic is the latest of Curgle Cranklehop's inventions. It is quite an impressive piece of machinery.

The Super Egg-O-Matic sputters wildly as you approach the control panel.
I have seen very few eggs retrieved from Feralas in extraordinary condition. These are eggs of the rarest sort...

complete.text:
So, you have found an ordinary egg, $N? Please give it to me... And we can only hope for the best.

I don't have much, but please accept this reward. If you ever find yourself in Feralas again, know that I am always here to take the eggs you find there.

progress.text: Ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch about half the time. We do our best to nurture them and with a little luck, they will hatch.

complete.text:
Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-22/FE!  I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance!  My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!

Please, take your choice of any of these items I have.  Thank you again for your generous assistance $N, my robots and I are in your debt!

Wonderful!  You found it!  And what's just as important--Velratha no longer has it!  Thank you, $N.  I am forever in your debt!

And if I sounded a little... mean before, pay it no mind.  You'll find me a much nicer person to those who haven't stolen from me.

progress.text: Do you have the tiara, $N?  Has Velratha learned the price of crossing me?

complete.text: Great, thanks for the shipment!  Now MacKinley and I can finally settle our wager.

progress.text: Did you find my shipment of rum, $N?

accept.text: Thanks again for your help, $n.  Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum.  Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.

complete.text:
Hm, let's try this...

I can't believe it!  This stuff is... terrible!  That's great!

Well I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me.  He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum.  That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!

objectives.text: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

progress.text: Did Stoley cough up my booze?

complete.text:
Ah, Andre's head.  So I guess he'll make his trial after all!

Much appreciated, $N.  Now if you'll just sign here, I can issue you payment for services rendered.

Don't worry about the small print.  It's harmless, and... I don't think there's a magnifying glass small enough to read it anyway.

progress.text: You look a little dazed.  Have you been reading our legal documents?

accept.text: This scroll contains the schedules of shipments between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. Both past and future shipments are included, along with ship names, with large 'X's next to some ships' journeys, and annotations like "GREAT LOOT" and "HARD FIGHT" next to others.$B$BSomeone at Steamwheedle Port would want to see this document.

complete.text:
Oh my, this looks to be a list of ship departures and arrivals, with accurate dates and times and everything!  If the captain of a pirate ship got his hands on this, he could have himself a field day!

You say you got this from a pirate?  Well that's disturbing news...

Thank you, $N.  I'm glad you took it from him, and I'm glad that pirate's eating dirt right now!

objectives.text: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.

progress.text: You look out of breath.  You have something to tell me?

accept.text: This map shows a stretch of beach with a southern face.  Below the map are words, elegantly written...$B$B$BSouth of Wheedle$BSouth of home$BFind a mast and flag and bones$BDig you there, if you be bold$BDig and claim Cuergo's gold!$BA key you'll need and a key you'll see$BThe men you face take blood as fee.

complete.text: Captain Cuergo's hidden treasure awaits!

objectives.text: Find Cuergo's gold!

progress.text: This chest is locked!

accept.text: $n, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!$B$BLong ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian," after the hydra god.$B$BI did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?$B$BI even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!

complete.text:
Perfect; these ornaments are perfect for my studies. Thanks so much for the help, $N.

Oh, can I get my helmet back?

objectives.text: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

progress.text:
Are you having any trouble?

You can find Gahz'ridian just about anywhere in Tanaris, $N, so keep looking!

complete.text:
They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...

But you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.

Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?

You look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...

accept.text: I once entered the foreboding chambers of the Sunken Temple. The evil in that place penetrates all that enter; I barely managed to find my way out, wading through the ooze that now covers the floors. All I can remember is stumbling through a large circular room, filled with serpent statues...$B$BRecently, I discovered a round stone that appeared to have the same serpent symbol imprinted on it. I had it packed up and shipped to my workshop in Ratchet. Retrieve it, and I might be able to tell you more.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

accept.text: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.$B$BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.$B$BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.

objectives.text: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

accept.text: Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave is in need of your services.  She is in the Badlands, in the orcish outpost of Kargath, pursuing rumors of a certain brew made by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.$B$BSpeak with Vivian.  She awaits you.

objectives.text: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

accept.text: Felwood is a forest far north of the Barrens, even farther than Ashenvale. There, slimes are found all around pools of water blessed by the touch of Fel. The Scourge decimated the area with attacks of Infernals and other demonic magics--the slimes supposedly crept up through the earth during these attacks.$B$BGather samples of Felwood slimes and we will use the testing equipment next to me to create a control group for our tests against other samples you gather.

objectives.text: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

accept.text: Have you heard of the Un'Goro Crater, $n? It is near the Tanaris desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life.$B$BIt is there you must go. Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets.$B$BI would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.

objectives.text: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

accept.text: Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value!  But... we might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.$B$BMy sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the Burning Steppes.  She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.$B$BSo, what do you say?  Want to help?  If so, then speak with my sister.  You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of Dreadmaul Rock.

objectives.text: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

accept.text: Being an apprentice to Marvon Rivetseeker, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.$B$BI've been reading about Un'Goro Crater most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.$B$BDo you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?

objectives.text: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

accept.text: The Forsaken apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences.$B$BI have been studying the plague for years, $r. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the Plaguelands is startling. The plague seems to be growing in strength!$B$BI need to run more tests! The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. Travel to Stratholme and bring me samples, $n.

complete.text: There is something that has changed in the chemical structure of the plague's active agents. More data is required.

objectives.text: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

progress.text: Some say I worry too much - to them I say, 'You don't worry enough!'

accept.text: You will have to delve deeper into Stratholme, $n.$B$BBeyond the first gates you will find the ziggurats. We know that the Scourge draws great power from these structures. Search the Ziggurats and return with any information that you may discover.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

accept.text: Terrible thing... what happened to Ezra. You see, the town was sacked and Ezra didn't want to leave his precious goods behind. The last thing I remember him saying was, 'I'll burn every last leaf before they get their damned, dirty hands on them!'$B$BI may love a good stogie but I'm no fool. I left Ezra and his delightful store that day. I assume he went down in flames but if there's a chance that even one box of his famous tobacco is still intact...$B$BWhat do you say, $n? Find a box for ol' Smokey?

objectives.text: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

accept.text: I look at my undeath as a malady, $r. An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead?$B$BI am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me.$B$BIf you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer.$B$BVenture to Stratholme and recover our surplus of holy water. Search the supply crates.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

accept.text: Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, $n. Take for example, the Scarlet Crusade. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?$B$BBlasphemers, one and all!$B$BOne in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of Stratholme: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

accept.text: There are those that died tragically in the fall of Stratholme. Many took their own lives, opting to hurl themselves into the myriad flames of the smoldering city rather than become one of the Scourge.$B$BThey now walk the streets of Stratholme as restless spirits.$B$BWe must aid them, $n!$B$BI have an associate named Egan who has been doing miraculous work with ghosts and souls. Seek him out. He walks the eastern Plaguelands, near Stratholme, testing his innovations.

objectives.text: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

accept.text: Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.$B$BWeldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.$B$BHe now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!

objectives.text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

accept.text: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.$B$BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $n.

objectives.text: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

complete.text:
All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission.  Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.

While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess.  Procure these insignia and bring them to me.  For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.

Achieve your destiny, $c - join the fight today!

accept.text: The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight!  We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across Azeroth unchecked!$B$BTheir necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.$B$BGo to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... before they get any bigger!

complete.text:
Well done, $N!  It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.

...At least, I hope it will!

objectives.text: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

accept.text: This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling.  But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred.$B$BBetina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.

complete.text: Excellent!  This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge.  Thank you, $N, and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!

objectives.text: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

progress.text: $N, do you have something to show me?

complete.text: I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, $N! Thanks for your help!

accept.text: Get me out of here!$B$BI came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines.  I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk!  I think they want to eat me!$B$BGet me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big!  He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.$B$BLet's hurry, $n.  Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...

objectives.text: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

accept.text: The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, $c. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.$B$BIf you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.$B$BOnce I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. These powers have been too long at rest...

complete.text:
Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.

<Willow mutters.>

...So easy to convince.

...Will do anything for the right price. Heh heh heh...

objectives.text: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

progress.text:
Don't ask questions!

You have my request.

accept.text: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.$B$BTake this vial, $n. Fill it at the orange crystal pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.$B$BFind the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...

complete.text:
Thank you for returning this, $N. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.

While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.

objectives.text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.$B$BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.$B$BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

progress.text: If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. We must do what we can, $N...

accept.text: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.$B$BVyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.$B$BYou must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.

complete.text: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.

objectives.text: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.$B$BFind a way to speak with Celebras.

progress.text: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...

accept.text: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.$B$BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.$B$BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!

complete.text:
Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. Much danger awaits you, $N.

Speak with me again should the need arise.

objectives.text: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.$B$BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.

accept.text: Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. The offspring of their time together became known to the people of Kalimdor as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.

complete.text:
This is most wonderful news, $N! Thank you!

I will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.

I was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.

objectives.text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

accept.text: The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.$B$BLook around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.$B$BBut there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.

objectives.text: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

progress.text:
You have the scent of corruption on you, $N... much like many adventurers these days. But something about you is different. Is there something you've come to speak to me about? You have an aura about you that seems familiar, but I cannot place it.

Please, I implore you, tell me why you've sought an audience with me.

accept.text: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.$B$BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.$B$BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.

objectives.text: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

progress.text: What did you decide, $N? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?

accept.text: I had let my guard down for only one moment, stranger. In my haste to escape the grip of the fallen Prince, I was robbed. A most foul demon, the imp Pusillin, pilfered my book of incantations and the key to the once great halls of Eldre'Thalas.$B$BI no longer hold interest in the key, as I have exchanged my immortality for freedom, but I desperately need my book of incantations.$B$BFind the imp, Pusillin, and recover my book.$B$BSearch the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul for Pusillin.

complete.text: You have found it! A curse upon that miserable imp. Alas, my material possessions are meager at best. You may choose from what I have to offer.

objectives.text: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.$B$BReturn to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

progress.text: I regret nothing, stranger. The Queen has long since passed. The works of the Shen'Dralar have been marred by the madness of Prince Tortheldrin. I seek only freedom... Escape...

accept.text: A $r mage! How wonderous. I have not seen one of your kind for... oh what is it going on now? 500 years!$B$BI have something that will quench your thirst, but first you must do a task for me.$B$B<Lydros snickers.>$B$BThere is an anomaly in Eldre'Thalas. A water elemental has taken residence in the east wing. His presence must be catalogued!$B$BVenture to the Warpwood Quarter and extract a portion of the elemental essence of the Hydrospawn. Return it to me and I shall teach you a useful cantrip.

complete.text: Wonderful! Who are you again? Oh it matters not. What was I supposed to give you? Hrm... well you are a $c, perhaps you will find this useful.

objectives.text: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

progress.text: Yes? Do I know you?

complete.text:
You have done well, $N.  This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire Maul, and I fear what damage may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris.  I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.

Thank you, $N.  I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris.  They will be the new wardens of its power.

progress.text: $N, do you have Lethtendris's Web?

accept.text: Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.$B$BDo me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.$B$BKill the whole lot of em!

complete.text: Oh, mon! I can't thank you enough! Hopefully this here fishing pole will be reward enough for the job.

objectives.text: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

accept.text: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.$B$BMon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.$B$BFind Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.

complete.text: MON! This is fantastic! With my best lure and the snapjaw population down, the fish will pile up.

objectives.text: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.$B$BKatoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

progress.text: Did you get it yet?

accept.text:
Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, skyborne. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.

This type of ferocity will not go unchecked!

You must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Silvermane Stalkers and 15 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

accept.text:
Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk $c has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.

Kill every savage owlbeast you see, skyborne. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.

Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.

Kill every savage owlbeast you see, skyborne. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.$B$BFor now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.$B$BSlay one and return to me with its plume.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.$B$BI want those tools back, $n - they mean the world to me.$B$BMarkhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.$B$BThose temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.$B$BRecover my tools!

objectives.text: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. You, on the other hand...

objectives.text: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.

accept.text:
As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived.

I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine.

The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.

complete.text:
<Mithera listens quietly to your explanation of the situation.>

The pedestal is empty? My necklace is... missing?

<A great sadness washes over her expression.>

I should have expected as much. The quilboar and the centaur have been ravaging these lands for such a short amount of time, but the damage they have already done is immeasurable.

$N, even if the magic is gone from the necklace, I am clinging onto hope that I may have it back. Would you be willing to help?

objectives.text: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.

accept.text:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.

complete.text:
It is remarkable to see that the pylons' power burns brightly once more. I am surprised I hadn't noticed before you arrived. I was beginning to think that this one would soon suffer the same fate, and we would be lost to time.

Thank you for tethering us back in full to Shen'dralas. Try to meet some of our denizens. They may be wary of you, but that will pass.

objectives.text: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.

accept.text:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.

complete.text:
<The flames that previously burned away at the treant's ghostly form have faded. Still, his gaze is hollow. It takes several moments of inaction before he regards your presence.>

My torment has ended. Peace approaches me.

No time for farewells. No time to wait for those that have forgotten me.

Traveler, I have one final thing to say. One last hope for your quest.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.

objectives.text: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.

complete.text: I knew you were coming this way by the smell. I appreciate you getting your hands dirty for us, so to speak. Now, go wash up in the river before we get to planting some trees.

objectives.text: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.

progress.text: Some folks think lumber work's a simpleton's job. They'd be dead wrong. Having skills like botany and chemistry can get you far in this business.

accept.text:
Considering you got yourself wrist-deep in guts and manure for us, it's only right you get to do the fun part too.

The boys and I gather seeds from the trees as we work. With the fertilizer you've provided, I've made a planting kit to put them in the ground to grow new saplings.

Take it, and find some good planting spots around the work sites.

complete.text: Nothing like a hard day's work, eh $N? Good on you for helping out.

objectives.text: Plant 5 saplings around the lumber camp with Halligan Turner's tree sprouting kit.

progress.text: We grow 'em up, cut 'em down, and grow 'em back up again. It's a beautiful cycle.

accept.text:

I work as a lumberjack for the nearby logging camp. As you can see, I've been trapped here in an accident. If I don't get out from here soon, I'll either bleed out, or be eaten by wild animals.

Please, go to the logging camp and fetch help!

complete.text: My brother's where?!

objectives.text: Go to Turner's Logging Camp and get help.

Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.

complete.text:
That damn kid...

Even if he is a knucklehead, Curly's a good worker. Hopefully he heals up fine and learns some sense. Things could've gone a lot worse if you hadn't been there. Thanks for looking out for him.

objectives.text: Go with Hurley to save Curly.

complete.text: You do your Alliance proud, $r. If the Stormwind aristocracy had even half your mettle, we'd have ended this war years ago.

In fact, Demar has news that may be of interest to us. Why don't you run along and speak to the good Knight Commander?

progress.text: The Twilight's Hammer are dogmatic, but hardly organized. You're likely to find their pages scattered throughout Sunnyglade.

complete.text: Excellent work, $c. I could feel the power you carry before you even entered the keep.

progress.text: You shouldn't have too much trouble finding charms off of Twilight's Hammer spellcasters. They seem to hoard them quite jealously.

accept.text:
